exact: gamma-aminobutyric acid uptake involved in synaptic transmission
narrow: gamma-aminobutyric acid import into glial cell
related: gamma-aminobutyric acid uptake during transmission of nerve impulse

definition: The uptake of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 4-aminobutyrate) by neurons or glial cells. This process leads to inactivation and recycling of neurotransmitters.
label: Reuptake of GABA
